observation.visible_scene: A woman in a dim gym lit with purple haze and vertical neon tubes (blue and pink) jumps rope. She wears a black halter tank top and camouflage shorts, with a ponytail. Faint 'IN PROGRESS' lettering is visible on the wall behind her. She holds a jump-rope handle in each hand and the rope sweeps around her body in a continuous cycle throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: The jump rope rotates around her in repeating cycles: the rope arc appears high above/beside her head in some frames (e.g., t=0.0, t=1.33, t=2.75) and low at her sides/hands in others (e.g., t=0.25, t=1.0, t=2.0), indicating continuous swinging rather than a start or stop.
Her ponytail flips upward and then settles repeatedly, synchronized with vertical jumps.
Her torso bobs up and down frame to frame as she hops, with the head shifting relative to the top edge of the frame.
Her arms and wrists rotate the handles in small circular motions consistent with rope turning.
The background neon tube and wall text shift position/length across the sequence, suggesting a slow camera tilt/zoom or reframing rather than subject translation.
outside_clip_unknowns: When the jump-rope session began and when it ends (both crop boundaries are mid-motion).
The total number of jumps or any trick sequence beyond this window.
What happens outside the visible frame (feet/landing surface, full rope length).
uncertain_details: Whether the apparent change in background framing is camera motion or subject movement; evidence is limited.
Exact rope path under the feet (occluded), so jump count per cycle is inferred from body/hair bobbing only.
Material of the rope and handles is not determinable from the frames.
